title: San Francisco Housing Authority’s worksheet fell $2.38 million short of reported fees

beats.text: The San Francisco Housing Authority reported more in fees than its worksheet supported.

visual.sub: Projects reported more in fees than the calculation supported

beats.text: The federal schedule showed $5,329,060 in property management fees.

visual.kicker: Projects reported more in fees than the calculation supported

beats.text: Auditors also checked a separate fee for overseeing assets.

visual.kicker: The same test found five projects used differing asset management rates

beats.text: Five housing projects used rates ranging from $10.02 to $10.30.

visual.kicker: The same test found five projects used differing asset management rates

beats.text: The audit classified the fee controls as a material weakness.

visual.kicker: The same test found five projects used differing asset management rates

beats.text: The auditors questioned about $2.38 million in property management fees.

visual.kicker: The audit’s estimate differs by $100 from its printed figures

beats.text: The difference between the printed figures exceeds the audit estimate by $100.
The 2017 audit recorded the finding as corrected.

visual.kicker: The next signed audit listed the finding as corrected

beats.text: It did not report a cash repayment or a final federal disallowance.
